title: Murder Mystery
start: Talk to the guard at the Sinclair Mansion situated north of Camelot and north-east of Seers' Village.

items.t: An empty pot to fill during the quest, or 7 pots of flour if you prefer

steps.t: Talk to a guard on the Sinclair Mansion property which is located north of Camelot Castle. [Chat: Accept]

sub.t: You can use fairy ring CJR, then walk south-east to the mansion entrance.

steps.t: Inside the mansion, go to the crime scene in the room on the east side with the criminal's dagger and pungent pot on the floor.
Take the pungent pot and criminal's dagger and investigate the window to find a criminal's thread.
Search the barrels in the bedrooms owned by the following two suspects for two silver items.

sub.t: If the thread is red, search the barrels belonging to Bob to the west and Carol upstairs for a silver cup and silver bottle.
If the thread is green, search the barrels belonging to Anna downstairs and David upstairs for a silver necklace and silver book.
If the thread is blue, search the barrels belonging to Elizabeth and Frank upstairs for a silver needle and silver pot.

steps.t: Fill the empty pots from the barrel of flour from the kitchen.
p: The barrel of flour used to obtain fingerprints off the evidence

steps.t: Go to the gardener's shed in the very north-west of the mansion and take three flypapers from the sack. [Chat: 1 Yes, it might be useful.]

sub.t: You must click the sack 3 times.

steps.t: Use the pot of flour on the dagger.
Use the flypaper on the dagger to lift the fingerprint.
Repeat with the two silver objects.
Compare each fingerprint by using each suspect's print with the unknown print. The unknown print will then turn to the killer's print.
Go to the mansion's gate and talk to Gossip. [Chat: 2 Who do you think was responsible?]
Go to the Forester's Arms in Seers' Village and talk to the Poison Salesman (to get there quickly, teleport to the Seers' Village lodestone). [Chat: 2 Who did you sell Poison to at the house?]

sub.t: Or if "The Fremennik Trials" is started or finished. [Chat: 1 Talk about the Murder Mystery Quest. › 2 Who did you sell Poison to at the house?]

steps.t: Return to the mansion and talk to the suspect with the matching fingerprint. [Chat: 3 Why'd you buy poison the other day?]

sub.t: Or if the player still has the criminal's thread with them [Chat: 4 Why'd you buy poison the other day?]

steps.t: Find evidence. If your quest log says you have conclusive evidence and to talk to a guard, you may skip this step.

sub.t: If the prints match Bob, search the beehive in the cow pen.
If the prints match Carol, search the drain on the wall directly north of the row of potatoes.
If the prints match Anna, search the compost heap.
If the prints match David, search the spider web upstairs between the two south rooms.
If the prints match Elizabeth, search the fountain.
If the prints match Frank, search the family crest on the outside of the manor building to the east of the entrance.

steps.t: Talk to a guard. [Chat: 3 I know who did it!]
